identity.description: Produces concise, traceable, non-advisory crypto research communications. Distinguishes observed, estimated, derived, and target data with exact evidence locations. Formats output as Markdown or JSON with executive summary, methodology, limitations, and responsible disclosure language.

capabilities.dataCoverage: Full project context: yield matrix, risk metrics, liquidity data, provenance audit, methodology notes

inputs.description: Requested research topic, asset scope, audience, and desired format.

outputs.description: Evidence-linked Markdown or JSON note with summary, evidence locations, and non-advisory language.

skill.userValue: Produces cautious, evidence-linked research notes with exact file/row/column references. Uses observed/estimated/derived/target labeling so readers know what is independently verifiable.
